id: 16_Replace the Main Control Board for xTool MetalFab Laser Welder
title: 激光焊接机主控板的规范更换（国内版）
source_doc: course/Cleanroom & Equipment Safety/16_Replace the Main Control Board for xTool MetalFab Laser Welder.md
author_source: project/Cleanroom & Equipment Safety/16_Replace the Main Control Board for xTool MetalFab Laser Welder（国内版）/src.py

shots.scene: 欣欣站在侧门打开的激光焊接机旁，指着机内一块长条电路板，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a gray wheeled laser welding machine with its side open, points at a long blank circuit board inside, and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课，看焊机的主控板怎样更换。
overlay: 激光焊接机主控板的规范更换

shots.scene: 主控板图标居中，四周箭头连向激光、报警灯、急停、送丝轮
shots.prompt_en: A circuit board icon in the center with arrows pointing to a laser beam icon, a warning light, an emergency stop button and a wire feeder wheel. No people.
shots.narration: 主控板是焊机的大脑，出光报警都归它管。

shots.scene: 阿杰开机，屏幕显示空白报警图标，焊枪不动作
shots.prompt_en: The young male student powers on the machine; its screen shows a blank warning icon and the welding gun does nothing.
shots.narration: 阿杰发现焊机一开机就报警。

shots.scene: 阿杰在手机上搜到一个陌生网站的下载按钮
shots.prompt_en: The young male student looks at his phone, which shows a blank download button on an unknown website.
shots.narration: 他想在网上找个程序刷一刷。

shots.scene: 小研摇头拿走手机，老李提着工具箱和新板盒走来
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student shakes her head and takes the phone, while the facility engineer walks in with a toolbox and a boxed new circuit board.
shots.narration: 小研拦住：交给老李，按规范换板。

shots.scene: 欣欣把一个陌生U盘和下载图标打叉
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot crosses out an unknown USB stick and a download icon with a big red X.
shots.narration: 固件和参数，不能自己乱刷乱改。

shots.scene: 主控板上的联锁、报警图标连着一把锁
shots.prompt_en: A circuit board icon with interlock and warning light icons, all connected to a padlock. No people.
shots.narration: 改错了，联锁和报警可能失灵。

shots.scene: 老李对着说明书，旁边厂家服务的空白图标
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer reads a blank manual next to a blank service hotline icon.
shots.narration: 需要升级，由厂家或授权人员处理。

shots.scene: 欣欣举着黄黑边框警示卡，卡面只有闪电和人形打叉图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a warning card with a yellow and black striped border, showing a lightning bolt icon and a crossed-out person icon.
shots.narration: 换主控板只限专业人员。

shots.scene: 机箱剖面示意：一边闪电图标，一边激光束图标
shots.prompt_en: A simple cutaway diagram of a machine cabinet with a lightning bolt icon on one side and a red laser beam icon on the other side. No people.
shots.narration: 机内高压和强激光，会触电、烧伤。

shots.scene: 拔掉插头的焊机内部，一个模块上闪电图标，旁边沙漏
shots.prompt_en: Inside an unplugged machine cabinet, one module shows a glowing lightning bolt icon, with an hourglass beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 断电后仍有残余高压，要等待。

shots.scene: 老李戴上厚绝缘手套
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer pulls on thick insulated gloves.
shots.narration: 全程戴好绝缘手套。

shots.scene: 工作台上摆着两把十字螺丝刀、一把镊子和一个装在粉色防静电袋里的新电路板
shots.prompt_en: On a workbench lie two cross-head screwdrivers, a pair of tweezers and a new blank circuit board inside a pink antistatic bag. No people.
shots.narration: 两把十字刀、镊子和新主控板。

shots.scene: 老李查看包装盒，盒子完好，封条未破
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer inspects the parts box; it is intact and its seal is unbroken.
shots.narration: 新板到货，先看包装完不完好。

shots.scene: 老李隔着防静电袋看电路板，对照空白清单打勾
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer examines the board through the antistatic bag and ticks a blank checklist.
shots.narration: 再看外观有没有损伤，型号对不对。

shots.scene: 有裂纹的电路板图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a circuit board with a crack and a bent pin, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 板子有裂、针脚弯，就不装。

shots.scene: 焊机背面接口全部空着
shots.prompt_en: The back of the laser welding machine with all sockets empty and the unplugged cables coiled on the floor. No people.
shots.narration: 确认所有连接都已断开。

shots.scene: 老李踩下脚轮刹车
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer presses down the brake on a caster wheel with his foot.
shots.narration: 四个脚轮全部锁住。

shots.scene: 焊机静静放着，墙上时钟指针转动
shots.prompt_en: The closed laser welding machine stands still while a wall clock shows time passing. No people.
shots.narration: 静置一段时间，放电、冷却。

shots.scene: 老李打开焊机左侧门板
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer opens the hinged left side door of the machine.
shots.narration: 打开左侧门板。

shots.scene: 老李拆送丝安装板周边螺钉
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer removes the screws around the wire feeder mounting plate.
shots.narration: 拆下安装板十四颗螺钉。

shots.scene: 老李拆黄绿色接地线的螺钉
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer removes the screw of the yellow-green earth wire.
shots.narration: 拆下接地线螺钉。

shots.scene: 安装板放平，露出机内右侧一块长条电路板
shots.prompt_en: The mounting plate is laid outward, revealing a long circuit board on the right side of the cabinet.
shots.narration: 放平安装板，主控板就在右边。

shots.scene: 画面一角是全景图，几个插头被虚线圈出，老李逐个拔下
shots.prompt_en: A small inset shows the whole board with several connectors circled in dotted lines, while the facility engineer unplugs them one by one.
shots.narration: 对照位置图，逐个拔下所有插头。

shots.scene: 插头上有一点胶，镊子先剥掉
shots.prompt_en: Close view of tweezers peeling a small blob of glue off a connector before it is unplugged.
shots.narration: 插头有固定胶，先用镊子剥掉。

shots.scene: 老李用十字刀拧下电路板四周的螺钉
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer removes the screws around the edge of the circuit board with a cross-head screwdriver.
shots.narration: 拆下主控板的固定螺钉。

shots.scene: 老李握住电路板边缘，把整块板取出
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer holds the circuit board by its edges and lifts it out of the cabinet.
shots.narration: 捏住板边，取下旧主控板。

shots.scene: 旧板装进防静电袋，贴空白标签，放进待返厂箱
shots.prompt_en: The old board is slipped into an antistatic bag, labeled with a blank tag and placed into a return box. No people.
shots.narration: 旧板装袋标好，按规定返厂或回收。

shots.scene: 备件柜里干燥剂和防静电袋整齐排列
shots.prompt_en: A spare parts cabinet with neatly arranged antistatic bags and desiccant packs. No people.
shots.narration: 备用板放干燥处，原包装不拆。

shots.scene: 电路板裸放在潮湿窗台的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a bare circuit board left on a wet windowsill, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 不裸放、不受潮、不压重物。

shots.scene: 老李从袋里取出新主控板，放到原位
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer takes the new circuit board out of its bag and places it in position in the cabinet.
shots.narration: 取出新主控板，装到原位。

shots.scene: 八颗螺钉逐一拧紧
shots.prompt_en: Eight screws are tightened one by one around the new board.
shots.narration: 用八颗螺钉固定。

shots.scene: 画面一角是位置图，老李按形状把插头插回
shots.prompt_en: A small inset shows connector positions while the facility engineer plugs each connector back by matching its shape.
shots.narration: 每个插头按形状，对准插回。

shots.scene: 插头硬塞进形状不符插座的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a connector being forced into a socket of a different shape, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 形状不对硬插，会插错口、烧坏板。

shots.scene: 机内风扇和散热孔示意，箭头表示气流
shots.prompt_en: A diagram of the cabinet fan and vent holes with arrows showing airflow. No people.
shots.narration: 主控板靠风扇和散热孔降温。

shots.scene: 一团线缆堵住风扇的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a tangle of cables blocking a cooling fan, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 线缆插头别挡住风道。

shots.scene: 焊机背面通风口前堆着纸箱的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of cardboard boxes piled against the vent of a machine, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 平时机器四周也别堆杂物。

shots.scene: 老李抬回安装板，接送丝电机线和接地线
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer lifts the mounting plate back and reconnects the wire feeder motor cable and the earth wire.
shots.narration: 接回电机线和接地线。

shots.scene: 螺钉装回，关上左侧门板
shots.prompt_en: All screws are refitted and the left side door is closed.
shots.narration: 装回螺钉，关好门板。

shots.scene: 老李把空白维修单交给阿杰，指着上面的一行
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer hands a blank repair sheet to the young male student and points at one line.
shots.narration: 修好交回，要告诉使用人换了什么。

shots.scene: 阿杰开机，小研在旁观察屏幕
shots.prompt_en: The young male student powers on the machine while the female graduate student watches the screen beside him.
shots.narration: 第一次使用，多留意有无异常。

shots.scene: 报警图标出现，阿杰停下并拿起电话
shots.prompt_en: A warning icon appears on the screen; the young male student stops and picks up the phone.
shots.narration: 再有报警，马上停机联系老李。

shots.scene: 欣欣站在焊机旁，身后浮现四个图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside the laser welding machine with four icons behind: a crossed-out download, a checklist, a spare parts cabinet and a cooling fan.
shots.narration: 固件不自改，新板先检查。

shots.scene: 欣欣伸出手指数着
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot counts on its fingers.
shots.narration: 插头对形状，风道不遮挡，修后要交代。

shots.scene: 欣欣、老李、小研和阿杰在焊机前挥手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot, the facility engineer, the female graduate student and the young male student wave goodbye in front of the laser welding machine.
shots.narration: 大脑换新，规矩不忘。下次见！
